payload.content: A weighted, felt-padded base keeps this 6.5-inch freestanding paper towel holder steady for easy tearing while the roll stands upright to save counter space. Crafted from solid brass, it brings a traditional look with subtle contemporary design elements and a substantial build you can rely on every day in the kitchen. {FINISH_SENTENCE} The space-saving countertop design is a smart alternative when an under cabinet paper towel holder isn’t an option, and the felt pad helps protect countertops from scratches. Finished with a designer coating for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. No assembly required, and it includes the paper towel holder. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty from Allied Brass for confidence that lasts.
